settings.heading: Write to us
settings.text: Questions about the course, your tools or which plan fits. We answer within a working day.
settings.card_text: Tell us what tools you have and what you want to make, and we will point you to the right place.
settings.ph_message: Your tools, your space, your question
settings.thanks: Thank you. We will write back within two working days.

settings.text: Anything else? Write to us and we answer within a day.

settings.question: Do I need a workshop?
settings.answer: No. A sturdy table in a spare room or a shed is enough for every project. Hand tools are quiet, so flats work too.

settings.question: Which tools do I need?
settings.answer: Eleven hand tools, listed with prices in the first lesson. Second hand is fine for most of them, and we show you what to look for.

settings.question: How long until I build something?
settings.answer: The cutting board is the end of module two. With one evening a week, most people get there in the second or third week.

settings.question: I am left handed. Will it work?
settings.answer: Yes. The lessons show which hand does what, and the drawings note where a left hander works from the other side.

settings.question: What wood should I buy?
settings.answer: Planed pine or poplar from any timber yard for the first projects, and oak or ash for the table. Every project has a cut list.

settings.heading: Make your first cut tonight
settings.text: The first lesson takes eight minutes. Fifty six lessons, five projects and a 30 day refund, for one payment.
